# neo's CI runs the guide-quality lint over its guides again

## Context

The guide-quality lint (#14354) hard-fails Mermaid reserved words and self-loops, dead local links, dead `ai:*` script refs, tool-table refs that resolve to no OpenAPI operationId, and ticket ids in `learn/guides`. The ticket-id rule is the operator's "guides describe, trackers decide" (#17574). Before the split, this repository ran it as `ai:lint-guides`. #17806 removed that script along with the received Brain code. The cut manifest gives `ai/scripts/lint/lint-guides.mjs` to the Brain (disposition `edge`), and no repository has run it since (defect-note `a03b68c6`). Only `check-relative-links` still guards these guides.

## The Problem

Measured 2026-10-29 with the Brain's lint (`--root` from neomjs/neo-agent-brain#1366) against `dev@cc24c59e0d`, it scans 10 full guides and 63 guide-series files. There are 5 warnings and 3 hard findings, all ticket ids that accumulated while nothing ran:
- `learn/guides/datahandling/PooledGridAnimation.md:38` and `:59` (`#6858`);
- `learn/guides/testing/WhiteboxE2E.md:69` (`#19655`). That sentence is also stale: it describes a retry bridge that `BRAIN_RETRY_BRIDGE` (`buildScripts/util/e2eCiSelection.mjs`) ended on 2026-10-25.

## The Fix

1. `.github/workflows/lint-guides.yml`: on `dev` pull requests and pushes that touch `learn/**` or the workflow, check out this repository and `neomjs/neo-agent-brain` at `dev`, as `test-e2e-brain.yml` already does for the Brain, then run `node <brain>/ai/scripts/lint/lint-guides.mjs --root .`. No `npm ci` is needed, because the lint uses only Node built-ins.
2. The three findings, rewritten to describe the mechanism. The `WhiteboxE2E.md` paragraph states today's behaviour: the tier runs without retries.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: a `dev` PR touching `learn/**` runs the guide lint over this repository's guides and fails on a hard finding.
- [ ] AC-2: the lint is green on this PR's head (0 hard findings).
- [ ] AC-3: `WhiteboxE2E.md` describes the tier's current retry behaviour and cites `e2eCiSelection.mjs`, not a ticket.

## Out of Scope

- The 5 warnings (no-mermaid in two guides, "framework" wording in `Introduction.md`). They are report-only, and each is an authoring call.

## Related

Blocked by neomjs/neo-agent-brain#1366 (PR neomjs/neo-agent-brain#1367), which adds `--root`. Prior: #14354, #17574, #17806.

Live latest-open + closed sweep: latest 12 open neo issues + a search for guide lint workflow / `lint-guides` CI at 2026-10-29T23:46:31Z, with no equivalent; #17809 is the link-guard precedent. A2A: no claim. Structure map: N/A, since this adds one workflow and edits two guides.

Retrieval Hint: "neo guide-quality lint workflow lint-guides --root Brain checkout ticket ids learn/guides restored"
